What is Tooleefy?

Tooleefy is a decentralized, offline-first collection of essential productivity tools. Unlike traditional web utilities that sync, store, or analyze your business files on third-party servers, Tooleefy operates completely client-side in your local browser sandbox. Whether you're a freelance consultant billing clients, a warehouse supervisor managing inventory dispatch, or a digital marketer deploying targeted campaigns, our tools provide high-speed, secure operations right on your device.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Are Tooleefy tools really free to use?

Yes! Every single feature, including bulk QR and barcode generation, is 100% free with absolutely no hidden subscription fees, credits, account limits, or trial walls.

Does Tooleefy store or upload my files or inputs?

No. Tooleefy utilizes zero-knowledge client-side rendering. PDF invoice building, barcode vector calculations, and QR code mapping occur fully in your browser memory. We have no backend databases capturing your customer or product profiles.

Can I use Tooleefy offline?

Yes. Once the page loads in your browser, the primary tools remain completely functional even without active internet connectivity, as all mathematical engines run locally.
